inner_arch_contract.downward_suspension_law: The spider-web net serves only as passage and support; all 14 civic forms hang downward beneath the net, lowering the center of gravity and stabilizing catwalk sway.
inner_arch_contract.upward_inversion_failure: Attempting to build upward above the catenary net (attemptUpwardBuild) creates an unstable inverted load that immediately tilts and topples into the chasm (standingUpwardStructures === 0 always).
inner_arch_contract.finite_lifespan_serenity: Because inhabitants know the net will last only a finite, measurable span (knownSpanLifespanYears < Infinity, maxSafeLoadKg = 540), hanging life downward within finite cable capacity increases civicSerenity (0.36 -> 0.95) and lowers existentialUncertainty (0.64 -> 0.05), making life less uncertain than in ground-bound cities (otherCitiesUncertainty = 0.78).

hard_gates.HG1_standalone: Zero http://, https://, ../, fetch(, XMLHttpRequest, or ES module imports; 0 console/page errors under file://.
hard_gates.HG2_morphology: All 5 required custom elements in body, zero generic container/control tags, 100% .oct-* classes, J_dom < 0.35.
hard_gates.HG3_causality: All 14 downward stones hangable and interactive; upward build attempts always topple (standingUpwardStructures === 0); hanging all 14 downward stones within maxSafeLoadKg raises civicSerenity >= 0.90 and drops existentialUncertainty <= 0.10.
hard_gates.HG4_viewports_and_plates: Zero overflow at 1280x800 and 390x844, prefers-reduced-motion honored, keyboard controls active, <octavia-plate-drawer> [P]/[Z]/[Escape] loads map.png (1600x1200) and image.png (1600x1000).
